name: Existing Ration Card Number
whatItMeans: The unique identification number printed on the applicant's current ration card.
whatToEnter: Enter the existing ration card number accurately as shown on the card.

name: Head of the Family Name
whatItMeans: The full name of the primary head of the household registered on the ration card.
whatToEnter: Enter the full name of the head of the family as per official records.

name: Current Address
whatItMeans: The residential address where the family is currently residing and registered.
whatToEnter: Enter the complete current residential address including house number, locality, and landmark.

name: New Address
whatItMeans: The new residential address to which the ration card is being transferred.
whatToEnter: Enter the complete new address where the family has shifted or intends to shift.

name: Reason for Transfer
whatItMeans: The official cause or justification for shifting the ration card location.
whatToEnter: Select or state the reason for transfer, such as job relocation, change of residence, or marriage.

name: District
whatItMeans: The administrative district associated with the new residential address.
whatToEnter: Select the name of the new district within Telangana.

name: Mandal
whatItMeans: The administrative sub-district or mandal of the new location.
whatToEnter: Select the appropriate mandal name for the new address.

name: Village or Ward
whatItMeans: The specific village or municipal ward of the destination area.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of the village or municipal ward for the new residence.

name: Fair Price Shop Number
whatItMeans: The identification number of the ration shop attached to the new locality.
whatToEnter: Enter the desired Fair Price Shop (FPS) number of the new area if known.

name: List of Family Members
whatItMeans: The details of all individuals currently listed on the ration card.
whatToEnter: Provide the names, ages, and relationship to the head of all family members undergoing transfer.

name: Applicant Mobile Number
whatItMeans: The active contact number of the applicant for receiving official status updates.
